scope: Independent static review of frozen group coordinator cache candidate, before any integration
reconstruction: Fresh forward and reverse git apply reproduce all three candidate paths and both original files exactly
Original mock_produce file is an exact prefix of the candidate, preserving every old test byte
Producer retains the same counts of pre-existing Tokio and synchronous test identities; one original test Shared initializer adds the new cache fields

blockers.title: Cached TCP descriptor remains owned after shutdown
blockers.detail: shutdown_group_coordinator keeps Some(entry) in Shared and uses close plus release_if_closed. For TCP release_if_closed shuts down the write half but retains ConnIo::Tcp; a live Producer clone keeps the descriptor in the slot even after the peer observes EOF or the watcher finishes. The mock Close event is handler termination, not a local fd-destruction witness.

blockers.title: Physical retirement not witnessed before cached redial
blockers.detail: Eviction and retriable responses use retire_produce_conn, then remove/replace the owner and dial. BrokerConn Drop only requests idle watcher abort; the watcher may still hold the stream Arc. The eight yields after half shutdown do not guarantee physical fd release before a later dial.

blockers.title: Provisional discovery and fallback owners are outside the durable slot
blockers.detail: Initial discovery holds bootstrap and target connections in local futures during TCP/ApiVersions/SASL, FindCoordinator and result-yield stages. Rediscovery can concurrently hold speculative, lookup and target connections; multi-bootstrap also uses task/ready sets. Cancellation can drop these owners before publication to the cache, while watcher abort is not a termination witness. Uncached fallback has the same limitation and redials on retriable response before retiring its old coordinator.

blockers.title: Close can return success without acquiring or retiring the cache
blockers.detail: shutdown_group_coordinator returns unit after its deadline and close_timeout only propagates a prior flush timeout. A manually polled, then parked group future can retain the slot and socket across shutdown; Notify cannot run an unpolled future, yet close can return Ok. Lease Drop also has a closed-load-before-unlock race with close timeout.

observations: The close Notify is enabled before checking the closed flag, preventing the ordinary missed-notification window for a future that is actually polled.
The cache key includes group id and checks idle, reauthentication and expiration before reuse; uncertain responses mark the cached entry non-reusable.
Busy callers fall back to the original per-call path; this allows concurrent groups but does not qualify same-group ordering or ownership in the fallback.
The close-time try_lock/yield loop can use substantial CPU until the deadline.
limitations: No Cargo build, Rust type-check, Clippy, runtime, live Kafka, TLS/SASL, or performance benchmark.
The patch was checked against v10 alone; no composite metadata-v3 or group-cache fix was tested.
Server EOF and mock handler termination do not prove local fd destruction or remote application outcome.
